يستهديا (form X)
# يَسْتَهْدِيَا (yastahdiyā) /jas.tah.di.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# يُسْتَهْدَيَا (yustahdayā) /jus.tah.da.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
